svg.title: finalizeDecisionOutput steps
svg.desc: Six ordered steps inside the new pure function, each tied to its acceptance criterion: drop invented citations, move flagged or unsupported items, check registers, set thesis fields, set returns, merge adjustments.
svg.text: Detail: finalizeDecisionOutput(raw, inputs), new in decision/finalize.ts

g.text: 1. Deep-copy, then drop citation IDs not in acceptedClaimIds
reuses dropInvalidCitationIds (artifact-evidence.ts); unique IDs into adjustments — AC-3
driver catalysts → monitoring drivers; gap or uncited risks → open gaps — AC-1, AC-2
3. Empty risk or catalyst register → error {path} (the only new failure)
returned by decisionOutputFormat().validate; the existing repair pass handles it — AC-4, AC-8
complete → true + code linkage; withheld → false + marker + reason, pending — AC-5
5. expected_return_matrix from inputs, status estimated | withheld | unavailable
returns from terminalReturns; withheld → all 7 null; dilution flag code-owned — AC-6
6. Merge adjustments into decision_record.adjustments; return {output, adjustments, gaps, errors}
idempotent: re-finalizing its own output changes nothing and opens no new gaps — AC-7

svg.text: Schema (decision/contracts.ts): nullable returns + status, monitoring drivers, adjustments — AC-7.
